ui.hero.title: Diagrams that check themselves
ui.hero.subtitle: FlowForge is a visual logic engine built on typed ports: instead of UML shapes you can connect however you like, the graph watches its own correctness.
ui.feature.typed_ports.title: Typed ports
ui.feature.typed_ports.body: Input, control, output, mechanism — the engine won't let you wire an output to an output.

ui.feature.realtime.body: Your team sees each other's cursors and edits instantly, no page refresh.
ui.feature.visibility.title: Flexible visibility
